subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states is NOT covered by the Deccan Plateau?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deccan Plateau:-**

 
 
• **It is a large plateau located in southern India, covering most of the Indian states of Karnataka, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.**
 
• The Deccan Plateau is known for its rich biodiversity, with a variety of flora and fauna, including several endemic species.
 
• The region is also home to several important cultural and historical sites, including the Ajanta and Ellora caves, the city of Hyderabad, and the ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Telangana**:-

 
 
• It is a state located in southern India, formed in 2014 after the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• It is known for its rich history and culture, as well as its IT industry and agricultural production.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra**:-
 
 
• It is a state located in western India, known for its capital city Mumbai, as well as its rich history, diverse culture, and vibrant economy.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh:-**
 
 
• It is a state located in southern India, known for its beautiful beaches, rich history and culture, and thriving IT industry.
 
• It is also home to several important pilgrimage sites, including the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh:-**
 
 
• It is a state located in central India, known for its rich cultural heritage, wildlife reserves, and historical sites, including the Khajuraho Group of Monuments and the Sanchi Stupa.
 
• It is also one of the largest states in India, both in terms of area and population.
